en: My, a visitor all the way out at the cape! Sit, sit.
I've spent my life learning the oldest moves there are, the ones only a starter grown to its full strength can bear.
Shall I teach one of those moves to a Pokémon of yours?
Show me the one you'd like to learn it, dearie.
So I'm to teach {thing} to your {wearer}?
There now, {wearer} has let go of {forgotten}. And...
Use it with care. A move like that takes everything out of the one who uses it.
Well, there's no hurry. The sea and I will still be here.
Oh, an Egg! Let it hatch first, dearie. It can't learn a thing in there.
That Pokémon can't learn any of my moves. Only a starter grown to its last form can.
Why, it knows the move already! There's nothing more I can teach it.
It isn't quite there yet. Those moves need a Pokémon that trusts its trainer with its whole heart.
Spend more time together and come back.
{forgotten} isn't a move to be given up like that. {wearer} didn't learn {thing}.
